title: Sources: Warriors, Curry reach 2-year extension worth $116 million - ESPN
description: Warriors star Stephen Curry agreed to a two-year, $116 million contract extension with the franchise, with a player option in 2028-29, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania on Friday.

title: Iran War Updates: Tehran proposes 7-day plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz as it seeks deal before U.S. midterms - CBS News
description: Iran's president says Tehran wants a deal with the U.S. before November's midterm elections, as the regime puts an offer on the table.

title: White House blocks CNN from trip on Air Force One - The Washington Post
description: The White House’s decision puts the state of the rotational TV pool, which resumed on Friday, in jeopardy once more.

title: Supreme Court lets Trump administration use revamped federal voter eligibility database for now - AP News
description: The Supreme Court is allowing states to resume using a controversial federal tool to check voter eligibility before the November elections. The emergency ruling lifts a lower court’s restrictions for now on the Trump administration's revamped version of the p…

title: Supreme Court for the third time rejects Republican redistricting push in Missouri - NBC News
description: WASHINGTON — For the third time, the Supreme Court on Friday shut down efforts by Missouri Republicans to use a new congressional map in the midterm elections that are already underway.
